body:
From the design review (#63). Split from #16.

The client for the teacher endpoint. A non-loopback URL requires an explicit `--dev-teacher` flag (#70); recommend an SSH tunnel or TLS for the LAN teacher, since the state block (cwd, output tails, history examples) is sent in clear. Request format and constrained decoding per #68.

**Done when:** tested against a local fake HTTP server (including malformed and over-long responses, rejected not repaired); a LAN URL without the flag is refused; the real LAN check is manual.
title: M0.8b — OpenAI-compatible client for the teacher, loopback-only by default
